title: Mia and the Aquarium Adventure
paragraphs: Mia moved to a new town in June. She had curly red hair and a yellow raincoat. Today she would meet her scout troop at the park. Mia felt nervous about meeting everyone new. She did not know a single person in the troop yet. Mia took a deep breath and walked toward the girls.

A girl with short black hair waved at her. Her name was Lena, and she wore a green vest. "Hi! Sit with us," Lena said with a grin. The troop leader held up a big blue map. "We are going to the aquarium next week!" she said. Mia had never been to one before.

On Saturday, the troop climbed onto a yellow bus. Mia sat beside Lena by the window. Lena had a bag of crackers and offered Mia one. "I was new last year too," Lena whispered. Mia smiled for the first time all morning. They giggled about the bumpy ride.

At last, the bus stopped in front of a huge aquarium. Mia pressed her nose against the cool glass. Inside, the air smelled like salt and sea water. Lena pointed at a sign that read "Welcome, Explorers!" "Wow, this place is amazing!" Mia whispered. Her worried feeling began to fade away.

Mia and Lena walked past a giant tank. A sea turtle glided slowly through the blue water. Its shell had green and brown patterns like a puzzle. Mia tapped the glass gently with one finger. The turtle blinked, as if it said hello back. Lena giggled and waved back at it.

Next, they stopped at a tank full of bright coral. Pink and orange branches swayed in the water. Lena pointed to a small orange fish hiding inside. "Let's be patient and wait," Mia said softly. Slowly, the little fish poked its head out. Both girls grinned at the cheerful fish.

The leader asked everyone to find a fish that shimmered. Mia and Lena teamed up for the hunt. They checked every tank with care. Lena spotted a silver fish gliding past the light. "You found it! Thanks for being my buddy," Mia said. Lena smiled and gave her a high five.

The silver fish was shimmering in the blue light. Its scales sparkled like tiny silver mirrors. Mia felt happy and very proud inside. She had made a real friend, and it felt wonderful. Lena said, "Let's be buddies every week!" Their whole troop clapped for them both.

On the bus ride home, Mia leaned against Lena. They shared a sleepy, happy smile. Mia remembered her nervous first morning at the park. Now she had a best friend and a whole troop. "See you next Saturday, Lena!" Mia said. Her new town felt like home at last.
